Title: Rules question re: Seraph's Second timing

Messages.Author: Dasein
Messages.Body:
OK a quick rules question that came up recently.
I have out Teresita the Godmother (who is a Seraph) and Ox, Viceroy of
the Hollows. Ox successfully performs the action Blooding, which makes
him Black Hand. Can Teresita play the Seraph's Second action modifier
when that action resolves?
It's only usable when a Black Hand vampire is acting, but after
resolution. We figured that by the time the action has resolved, Ox
has become Black Hand, and he has then become a legal target for
Seraph's Second. So it was legal and Ox untaps, ready to cause some
trouble.

Did we get this right?

Messages.Author: LSJ
